translations.web: He who has pity on the poor lends to Yahweh; he will reward him.
translations.bsb: Kindness to the poor is a loan to the LORD, and He will repay the lender.
translations.kjv: He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the LORD; and that which he hath given will he pay him again.
translations.asv: He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto Jehovah, And his good deed will he pay him again.
